annotations.title: Push a new version of a file

description:
Push a new version of an existing artifact. Referencing collections bump their revision and clear collection-level approvals. For a larger or binary file use `kythe version <collection-id> <file>` (it matches the file to the artifact by name), which reads the bytes off disk - up to 32 MiB per artifact - instead of routing them through the model.

Over MCP the whole request is limited to 1048576 bytes, and base64 inflates content by 4/3, so roughly 786432 bytes of file is the practical maximum here. Larger content goes over the API or the CLI, which have no such ceiling.

artifactId.description:
artifact_id is the artifact to add a new version to (from get_artifact or a
 collection's artifact list).

content.description: content is the new version's bytes.

mime.description: mime overrides the artifact's content type; empty keeps it.

note.description: note is an optional version note describing what changed.

producer.description:
producer names the publishing instance (e.g. "claude-on-heavy"); defaults
 to the authenticated user's name.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: push_version
